```sql
WITH ness_city_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Ness City' AND border_type ILIKE 'city'
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(rast, (SELECT geom FROM ness_city_geom), TRUE) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM ness_city_geom))
)
SELECT 
  MAX((ST_Value(rast, 1))::numeric) - MIN((ST_Value(rast, 1))::numeric) AS elevation_difference
FROM clipped_dem;
```
